cases.observation: At frame14 (~0.28s), paired 3D and orthographic views show coherent bulk fluid and paddle, with small localized upper-corner jets and detached blue points. cases.limitation: This selected-image review does not measure containment or establish whether each detached point exits through the open top; sparse early out-of-envelope points remain an explicit limitation, without Q-N or numerical-accuracy grant.
